sources.title: Atomic-Germ/LFM2-2.6B-Transcript-NPU2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Based on LFM2-2.6B, LFM2-2.6B-Transcript is designed for private, on-device meeting summarization. We partnered with AMD to deliver cloud-level summary quality while running entirely locally, ensuring that your meeting data never leaves your device.

sources.title: Atomic-Germ/LFM2-1.2B-NPU2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New architecture - LFM2 is a new hybrid Liquid model with multiplicative gates and short convolutions. Flexible deployment - LFM2 runs efficiently on CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware for flexible deployment on smartphones, laptops, or vehicles.
